data.narrative:
Wispr AI is a Series A biotech and health company founded by Tanay Kothari and Sahaj Garg that has raised $81M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage peers in Biotech & Health, including Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Stage-progression valuation is the applicable method given data constraints. Using $81M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement yields an implied value of $162M. Peer-median analysis is not viable: while 8 same-sector peers exist, insufficient overlap across stage and valuation tier prevents a statistically meaningful comparison. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiple (median 5.6x across the three public tickers) cannot be applied without disclosed revenue data, which is unavailable for private companies.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $138M (low) to $186M (high), centered on $162M. This range reflects the single applicable method and therefore carries material uncertainty. Key limitations include reliance on a single valuation approach and lack of revenue visibility to cross-check via public comparables. The range should be stress-tested against burn rate, time-to-next-milestone, and any available operational metrics before final investment decision.
